title: CFPB Consumer Complaint Database
questions: consumer complaints about debt collection by state
complaints against a company by product
monthly complaint trend for student loans
share of complaints closed with monetary relief

manual.how: Open the links in INSTRUCTIONS.md (complaint lists as CSV, counts as JSON) in a browser, or use the database page https://www.consumerfinance.gov/data-research/consumer-complaints/search/ (set the filters, Export data > CSV), and upload the files.

cache.why: The database is refreshed daily and complaints are added for weeks after a date; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: CFPB publishes the complaint data under CC0 (the API's _meta.license field says CC0); attribution to CFPB requested.

notices: Complaint counts are not a measure of how common a problem is: complaints are not a statistical sample, larger companies receive more, and CFPB does not verify every claim (CFPB data-use guidance).
citation: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, Consumer Complaint Database ({dataset}), consumerfinance.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.

audit_hooks.why: CFPB asks users not to treat complaint counts as representative of all consumers' experience.

clarify: Which date: when CFPB received the complaint (date_received, the default) or when it was sent to the company?

Product names changed over time (e.g. 'Credit reporting, credit repair services, or other personal consumer reports' became 'Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports'): combine the old and new names for a trend?
